results.trackName: Her Billionaire Hero: A Friends to Lovers Second Chance Romance
results.description:
I didn't believe in love at first sight until I met my new billionaire boss!

He was tall, muscular, and extremely handsome!

He was nothing like my ex-husband

My ex didn't treat me like woman

I don't know how I accepted to marry him in the first place.

It made me sick to think that he had an affair a long time ago, and I didn't know about it until now.

Things weren't going to work out for us.

I'm glad we got a divorce.

My boss is so much different

I shouldn't want him, but when he is around me, I can't stop feeling the way I do.

I should get away from him as much as possible, but when he opens his heart, I can't turn him away.

And the more I know, the more I want him.

I don't know how to stop these feelings

Our love is strong – I have to make sure time doesn't allow it to fade. Some things are too important to wait for.
